panels.title: Kafka Consumer Lag (max per instance)
panels.description: kafka_consumer_fetch_manager_records_lag_max, one series per consumer client — a real, first-class monitored metric (claude.md's own phrase), not a Kafka UI screenshot you have to remember to check.

panels.title: HTTP Request Rate by Service
panels.description: rate() of http_server_requests_seconds_count, auto-instrumented for every @RestController by spring-boot-starter-actuator — zero manual counter code anywhere in this project.

panels.title: HTTP Error Rate (5xx) by Service
panels.description: Same metric as the panel above, filtered to 5xx status codes — the rate limiter's own 429s (Build Order Step 9) are 4xx, deliberately NOT counted here, since a client being correctly rate-limited isn't a server error.

panels.title: Kafka Listener Throughput by Service
panels.description: rate() of spring_kafka_listener_seconds_count — how many Kafka records per second each service's @KafkaListener methods are actually processing, combined across every listener in that service.

panels.title: Dead-Lettered Messages (total)
panels.description: inventory.dlt.messages_total — claude.md's 'dead-letter-topic alerting story,' made real: a message landing in order-created-dlt (Build Order Step 4) now increments a Micrometer counter instead of only producing a log line nobody's watching.
